editorial:
Imagine a guy who just cannot stop fighting everyone he meets. That is exactly who you get with the lead character in this flick. He is a loose cannon who thinks punching people is the best way to solve any problem. Then you have the female lead, who sees something special in him despite his temper. She is totally head over heels for him, and while he eventually agrees to marry her, there is a big catch. Her father is not about to let a violent stranger into the family without a fight. He makes a deal that the guy has to drop the toughness and work at his factory to prove he can actually be a productive member of society.

You will probably love the chemistry between the leads and the funny moments when the tough guy tries to play nice at work. The action scenes are loud and punchy, though some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable. If you enjoy old-school romance mixed with street fights, this is for you. Since it is an older title, you should try to find the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to get the best picture quality, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the hero's past violence catches up with him one last time. After proving his worth at the factory and showing her father he can be disciplined, he faces a final showdown with the villains. He uses his strength for the right reasons to protect his new family. Once the bad guys are defeated, the father finally gives his blessing, and the couple gets married in a happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s action movies and stories about changing for love.
